title: 第一卷第3章 怒火冲霄第一卷第4章 哥哥会永远保护你
content_zh:
;;
从永生神殿出后，君无邪看着住了半年的破烂院子，不胜唏嘘。
想当初，他没有失去混沌神脉时，整个萧家上至元老下至普通族人，哪个对他不是客客气气的？
他出事后，一个个却是落井下石，百般针对与刁难。
“现实很残酷，没有了价值，命如草芥，被人弃之如敝履！”
君无邪有些感慨，他摇了摇头，不再去想那些，提升实力才是最重要的，得尽快弄到初灵丹。
早些突破到先天境，肉身强度就能达到一星灵兵的程度，且到了先天境可以修炼武技，实力将会得到飞跃式的提升。
离开破院，君无邪前往家族资源房，那里常备着供族人冲击先天境的初灵丹。
丹药品级共有九星，每一星又分下品、中品、上品、绝品。
初灵丹是一星下品之下的准灵药，即便如此，也是价格昂贵，一枚市价百金，足够青阳城普通五口之家生活三年之需。
普通武者冲击先天境，需要准备十枚初灵丹，而他至少需要百枚，甚至数百枚！
“资源房存量肯定不够，我还得再想别的办法……”
他一边走着一边思量，一道冷漠的呵斥声打断了他的思绪。
“小贱婢，你竟敢跑到厨房来偷东西！”
“我没有，我好饿，我只是捡了你们吃剩下扔掉的……”
君无邪心一紧，转身冲向声音传来的方向——家族厨园。
一到厨园，他就看到小月瑶背着小药篓倒在地上，一位满脸横肉的中年的人正凶狠地看着她。
小月瑶眼里噙着泪水，手里紧紧抓着半个馒头，脏兮兮的小脸又红又肿，五个指痕清晰可见，嘴角还有血渍。
“萧三雄！你他妈的敢打她？”
君无邪的怒火瞬间冲上头顶，半年来家族嫡系欺负她，可没有想到这些下人也欺负她！

“是你？你居然能下床了？”萧三雄眼睛瞪大了眼睛，跟见鬼了似的，随即回过神来，抱着双手讥笑道：“原来是我们萧家的少主啊，这才刚能下床走动，就忍不住耍威风了？不错，我打了她又怎样？”
轰的一声！
君无邪如一头暴怒的狮子，一脚将厨园管事萧三雄踢飞，把一辆拉菜的木车砸得四分五裂。
“君无邪！”萧三雄捂着小腹蜷缩在地上，只觉得五脏六腑都移了位，剧痛钻心，眼神狠毒：“你居然敢打我，你知不知道我背后的人是谁？”
整个厨园，一群下人噤若寒蝉，全都不敢说话。
那个瘫痪的少主，不但站起来了，实力似乎也恢复了！
想到自己这半年来也欺负过小月瑶，一个个都低着头，惶恐不安。
“月瑶，疼不疼？”君无邪将小月瑶拉了起来，拍掉她身上的灰尘，擦着她脸上的污渍与血渍，看到她手里攥着的半个馒头，鼻尖一酸。
这个馒头沾满了污渍，一看就是在潲水桶里面捡来的。
可即便是这样，这些畜生还是要欺负她！
“无邪哥哥，呜呜，你终于好起来了！”小月瑶眼里的委屈一下子变成了喜悦。她喜极而泣，抹着眼泪说道：“月瑶要给哥哥采好多好多的药，让哥哥身体恢复得跟以前一样强壮！”
“月瑶……”
“无邪哥哥，你怎么哭了。”她用小手抹着君无邪眼角的泪水，泣声道：“无邪哥哥不哭，月瑶也不哭……”
“好，不哭。”君无邪将她拉到一个角落，道：“月瑶，看哥哥怎么收拾欺负你的人！”
他转身，眼神瞬间森寒得似一头嗜血的狼，上前将萧三雄拎了起来：“说！你刚才用哪只手打的她！”
“你……”萧三雄吓得身子都软了，嘴里却叫嚣：“君无邪，你以为自己还是萧家少主？立刻放开本管事，否则……”
啊！
萧三雄狠话还没有说完，右臂就被君无邪给生生拧了下来，鲜血溅射，顿时吓得这里的下人一片尖叫。

;;
After coming out of the Temple of Eternal Life, Jun Wuxie looked at the dilapidated yard where he had lived for half a year and felt sad.
Thinking back to the beginning, when he had not lost the Divine Veins of Chaos, who in the entire Xiao family, from the elders to the ordinary members of the clan, were not polite to him?
After his accident, everyone started to add insult to injury, targeting and making things difficult for him in every possible way.
"The reality is cruel. We have no value, our lives are like grass, and we are abandoned like worn-out shoes!"
Jun Wuxie felt a little emotional. He shook his head and stopped thinking about that. Improving his strength was the most important thing. He had to get the First Spirit Pill as soon as possible.
If you break through to the Xiantian realm early, your physical strength will reach the level of a one-star spiritual weapon. When you reach the Xiantian realm, you can practice martial arts, and your strength will be greatly improved.
After leaving the ruined courtyard, Jun Wuxie went to the family resource room, where the first spirit pills for clan members to enter the Xiantian realm were always kept.
There are nine stars in the elixir grade, and each star is divided into low-grade, medium-grade, top-grade, and top-grade.
The Chu Ling Dan is a quasi-miraculous medicine with a low grade of one star. Even so, it is expensive. The market price of one pill is 100 gold, which is enough for an ordinary family of five in Qingyang City to live for three years.
Ordinary warriors need to prepare ten primary spirit pills to attack the Xiantian realm, but he needs at least a hundred, or even hundreds!
"The stock of resource rooms is definitely not enough. I have to think of other ways..."
As he walked and thought, a cold scolding interrupted his thoughts.
"You little bastard, how dare you come to the kitchen and steal something!"
"I didn't. I was so hungry. I just picked up what you left and threw away..."
Jun Wuxie's heart tightened, and she turned around and rushed towards the direction from which the sound came - the family kitchen garden.
As soon as he arrived at the kitchen garden, he saw Xiao Yueyao lying on the ground with a small medicine basket on her back, and a middle-aged man with a sinister face looking at her fiercely.
There were tears in Xiao Yueyao's eyes, and she was holding half a steamed bun tightly in her hand. Her dirty little face was red and swollen, five finger marks were clearly visible, and there were blood stains on the corners of her mouth.
"Xiao Sanxiong! How dare you fucking hit her?"
Jun Wuxie's anger instantly surged to the top of her head. For half a year, her direct family members had bullied her, but she never expected that these servants would also bully her!
"Is it you? You can actually get out of bed?" Xiao Sanxiong's eyes widened, as if he had seen a ghost. Then he came back to his senses, folded his hands and sneered: "It turns out it's the young master of our Xiao family. Just now he can get out of bed and walk around, and he can't help but show off his authority? Yes, so what if I beat her?"
Boom!
Like a furious lion, Jun Wuxie kicked the kitchen manager Xiao Sanxiong away and smashed a wooden cart pulling vegetables into pieces.
"Jun Wuxie!" Xiao Sanxiong covered his lower abdomen and curled up on the ground. He felt that all his internal organs had shifted. He was in severe pain and his eyes were vicious: "How dare you hit me? Do you know who is behind me?"
In the entire kitchen garden, a group of servants were silent, and no one dared to speak.
The paralyzed young master not only stood up, but also seemed to have recovered his strength!
Thinking that they had bullied Xiao Yueyao in the past six months, everyone lowered their heads and felt uneasy.
"Yue Yao, does it hurt?" Jun Wuxie pulled Xiao Yueyao up, patted the dust off her body, wiped the stains and blood stains on her face, and saw the half steamed bun in her hand, and the tip of her nose felt sour.
This steamed bun was stained, and it looked like it had been picked up from a bucket.
But even so, these beasts still want to bully her!
"Brother Wuxie, woo woo, you are finally feeling better!" The grievance in Xiao Yueyao's eyes suddenly turned into joy. She cried with joy and said while wiping her tears: "Yue Yao wants to collect a lot of medicine for my brother so that he can recover as strong as before!"
"Yue Yao..."
"Brother Wuxie, why are you crying?" She wiped the tears from the corners of Jun Wuxie's eyes with her small hands and cried: "Brother Wuxie doesn't cry, and Yue Yao doesn't cry either..."
"Okay, don't cry." Jun Wuxie pulled her to a corner and said, "Yue Yao, let's see how brother deals with those who bully you!"
himTurning around, his eyes were as cold as a bloodthirsty wolf, and he stepped forward to lift Xiao Sanxiong up: "Tell me! Which hand did you use to hit her just now!"
"You..." Xiao Sanxiong was so frightened that his body softened, but he shouted: "Jun Wuxie, do you think you are still the young master of the Xiao family? Let me go immediately, otherwise..."
Ah!
Before Xiao Sanxiong could finish his harsh words, Jun Wuxie had his right arm twisted off, blood splattered, and all the servants here were frightened and screamed.
